```{r}
# ── Year count for spline df (full study period) ──────────────
yr_num = length(unique(year(df_event$date)))

# ── RQ2: Storm exposure → crisis call rate ─────────────────────
mod_rq2 = glm(
  num_calls ~ period +
    ns(date, df = 4 * yr_num) +   # long-term trend + seasonality
    factor(dow) +                  # day-of-week effect
    factor(state_fips),            # state fixed effects
  family = quasipoisson(),
  offset = log(population / 100000),
  data   = df_event
)

# Extract IRR for each period vs pre
coefs_rq2 = summary(mod_rq2)$coefficients
periods   = c("periodacute", "periodshort_term", "perioddelayed")

results_rq2 = tibble(
  period = c("acute", "short_term", "delayed"),
  IRR    = exp(coefs_rq2[periods, "Estimate"]),
  lower  = exp(coefs_rq2[periods, "Estimate"] - 1.96 * coefs_rq2[periods, "Std. Error"]),
  upper  = exp(coefs_rq2[periods, "Estimate"] + 1.96 * coefs_rq2[periods, "Std. Error"]),
  p      = coefs_rq2[periods, "Pr(>|t|)"]
)

print(results_rq2)

# ── RQ3: Storm exposure → call abandonment rate ────────────────
# pct_calls_abandon is already a rate (%), gaussian is appropriate
mod_rq3 = glm(
  pct_calls_abandon ~ period +
    ns(date, df = 4 * yr_num) +
    factor(dow) +
    factor(state_fips),
  family = gaussian(),
  data   = df_event
)

# Extract β (percentage point change vs pre)
coefs_rq3 = summary(mod_rq3)$coefficients

results_rq3 = tibble(
  period = c("acute", "short_term", "delayed"),
  beta   = coefs_rq3[periods, "Estimate"],
  lower  = coefs_rq3[periods, "Estimate"] - 1.96 * coefs_rq3[periods, "Std. Error"],
  upper  = coefs_rq3[periods, "Estimate"] + 1.96 * coefs_rq3[periods, "Std. Error"],
  p      = coefs_rq3[periods, "Pr(>|t|)"]
)

print(results_rq3)
```
